facts.fact: The Ministry of Commerce says the GUCE-CI single window lets traders complete import, export and transit formalities entirely online and is the central digital interface between operators, public administrations and banks, with ten years of service.

systems.country_label: Guichet Unique du Commerce Extérieur de Côte d'Ivoire

CIV.note: GUCE-CI is a trade single window for operators, and no platform exchanging data between government systems is described.

facts.fact: The GUCE-CI single window lets businesses do import, export and transit formalities online without travelling, and users track their procedures in real time on its website and the GuceMobil app, the ministry says.

CIV.note: No count of services is given.
